script_text: Stop scrolling! Mars squares your adventurous spirit, igniting a sudden clash between ambition and impulse. Mercury dances with Saturn, urging you to pause before signing any contracts—delay could save you costly mistakes. Venus glides into your 9th house, opening doors to foreign ideas and spontaneous travel; trust the unexpected guide. Your ruling element, fire, burns brighter when you align with truth, so speak your mind but temper it with compassion. By Sunday, the planetary tide eases, gifting you clarity and renewed confidence. Embrace the challenge, Sagittarius, and let the cosmos steer your bold journey forward and inspire those around you.
